title: Access Policies
subtitle: Define who may do what on which data as W3C ODRL policies. Audiences describe who, asset collections describe what; active policies are evaluated deterministically and compiled into reviewed releases for connected platforms.

list.audiencesHint: Audiences (ODRL PartyCollections) are reusable groups of principals: explicit users/groups, refined by attributes such as Ontos Business Roles. They are independent of Ontos Teams.
list.collectionsHint: Asset collections (ODRL AssetCollections) are reusable sets of data assets: explicit UC securables, refined by classification, tag or domain.

description.policy: An ODRL policy: permissions, prohibitions and obligations on assets for audiences or principals.
description.audience: An ODRL PartyCollection: listed principals, narrowed by the refinement (all must hold). With no principals listed, the refinement selects from all principals; with neither, the audience is empty.
description.asset_collection: An ODRL AssetCollection: listed assets (a catalog or schema covers its children), narrowed by the refinement.
description.target: Where compiled policies ship: a platform, the securables it manages, and how releases may be delivered.

form.personalDraft: Create as personal draft (only visible to me)
form.jsonHint: Rules in ODRL JSON: {"permission": [...], "prohibition": [...], "obligation": [...]}. Compact rules are expanded to atomic rules on save.
form.builderUnsupported: These rules use constructs the builder can't show (logical or inline collections). Keep editing them as JSON.
form.valid: Valid against ODRL 2.2 and the Ontos profile.
form.principalsHint: One per line: group:<name>, user:<email> or sp:<id>. Leave empty to select purely by the refinement.
form.assetsHint: One per line, e.g. uc:catalog.schema or uc:catalog.schema.table. A catalog or schema covers its children.
form.audienceRefinementHint: Members must also satisfy these conditions (e.g. Business role = Analyst).
form.assetRefinementHint: Assets must also satisfy these conditions (e.g. Classification = pii).
form.refinementUnsupported: This refinement uses logical constraints; it is kept as-is.
form.contentLocked: This version is {{status}} — rules and membership are locked. Send it back to draft (while under review) or create a new version to change them; name, ownership, domains and tags stay editable.
form.offerForHint: Every Agreement concluded for this product (approved access request) inherits this Offer's prohibitions and obligations. An Offer itself grants nobody access.

check.title: Check access
check.descriptionAll: Evaluate a request against all active policies and see exactly why it is allowed or denied.
check.descriptionPolicy: Evaluate a request against this policy (what-if, any status) or against all active policies.

import.title: Import ODRL policy (JSON-LD)
import.description: Paste a W3C ODRL 2.2 policy. It is imported as a new draft; its declared conflict strategy is kept (the spec default is 'invalid').

details.rulesHint: Atomic ODRL rules. Prohibitions vs. permissions are resolved by the conflict strategy.
details.audienceSemantics: A principal is a member if it is one of the listed principals (or any principal, if none are listed) and it satisfies the refinement. An audience with neither matches nobody.
details.collectionSemantics: An asset is a member if it is (below) one of the listed assets (or any asset, if none are listed) and it satisfies the refinement. A collection with neither matches nothing.
details.jsonldHint: The policy as a W3C ODRL 2.2 document (Ontos profile).
details.newVersionHint: Creates a draft copy of v{{version}}. The current version stays in effect until the new one is activated.
details.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} v{{version}}? This cannot be undone.
details.personalDraftMessage: Only you (and admins) can see this personal draft until it is activated.
details.fromAccessGrant: Recorded from an approved Access Grant
details.offerFor: Terms of use (Offer) for data product

releases.hint: A release compiles all active policies for a target into concrete grants, diffs them against the Grant Ledger and ships the change through the Delivery Modes after review.

modeHint.direct: Apply GRANT / REVOKE now via the Databricks SDK; the ledger updates per applied item.
modeHint.indirect: Write the release as Ontos YAML to the Git repository for your CI to apply.
modeHint.manual: Notify admins with a SQL runbook to run by hand.

releases.deliverDescription: Choose the Delivery Modes to use. Only modes enabled in Settings → Delivery are available.
releases.noModes: No Delivery Mode is enabled. Enable one in Settings → Delivery.
releases.confirmDescription: Confirm the release was applied on the target (e.g. the Git change was merged and run, or the SQL runbook was executed). The Grant Ledger is updated accordingly.
releases.awaitingConfirmation: Delivered via Indirect / Manual mode. Confirm once the change was applied on the target — until then the Grant Ledger is unchanged.
releases.liveMissing: Desired but not granted on the platform
releases.liveStale: Granted by Ontos but no longer desired
releases.description: Compiled desired state of all active Access Policies for this target.
releases.errorsBlock: Errors block review — fix the policies and recompile.
releases.changesHint: Diff against the Grant Ledger; {{unchanged}} grants unchanged. Grants Ontos didn't apply are never revoked.
releases.gatedHint: These permissions need a workflow (duties, purpose) or attribute-based enforcement and are never granted unconditionally.
releases.untrackHint: These grants already existed on the platform before Ontos applied them. Ontos stops tracking them and does not revoke them.

ledger.hint: Grants Ontos applied through releases and tracks — the basis for time-bound (GDPR) revocation. Grants created outside Ontos are not listed.
ledger.impliedTitle: Parent privilege (USE CATALOG / USE SCHEMA) required to reach the granted object
ledger.preexistingTitle: Already on the platform when Ontos applied it — Ontos never revokes it

duties.title: Duties
duties.openHint: {{count}} open — the access is granted once every duty is fulfilled.
duties.byGrantee: To be accepted by the grantee
duties.byAdmin: To be fulfilled by an Access Policies admin

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.notFound: Agreement not found, or you are not its party.

targets.hint: Targets decide where releases compile to. While no Unity Catalog target is active, the built-in 'uc' target covers all of Unity Catalog. Two active targets of one system may not overlap.
targets.keyHint: Stable identifier releases and the Grant Ledger use (e.g. uc, uc-prod). Fixed once the target has more than one version.
targets.scopeHint: Securable prefixes this target manages, one per line (catalog or catalog.schema). Empty = everything in the system. Narrowing the scope stops tracking grants outside it; they are never revoked.
targets.deliveryModesHint: None selected = any mode enabled in Settings.
targets.scheduleHint: Cron expression (Quartz or 5-field). Drift is reported, never auto-fixed.
targets.semantics: Releases for this target compile only the securables in its scope and ship through its allowed delivery modes.

drift.title: Drift
drift.hint: Report only: the Grant Ledger compared with the live grants. Nothing is granted or revoked. The hourly job checks each target when its reconcile schedule is due.
drift.unreadable: Live grants can't be read from this platform yet — no drift check.
drift.missing: Tracked by Ontos, not on the platform
drift.unmanaged: On the platform, not tracked by Ontos
drift.truncated: Only the first securables were checked.
